title: One Edit Distance
description: Determine if two strings are exactly one edit distance apart.
pseudocode:
1. if abs(len(s) - len(t)) > 1 return false
2. for i in range(min(len(s), len(t))):
3.   if s[i] != t[i]:
4.     if len(s) == len(t): return s[i+1:] == t[i+1:]
5.     if len(s) < len(t): return s[i:] == t[i+1:]
6.     return s[i+1:] == t[i:]
7. return abs(len(s) - len(t)) == 1

steps.note: Check length difference between 'ab' and 'acb'. Difference is 1, continue.
len(s) < len(t) (2 < 3). Check if 'b' == 'b'. Returns true.
